# Returns, refunds, and warranty

Nook Home support policies. These are the rules support agents follow; quote them to customers in plain words.

## Returns

### Returns: window

Any device can be returned within 30 days of delivery, opened or unopened, for a full refund. This includes devices that have already been set up.

### Returns: how to start

To start a return, the customer opens Orders in their account, picks the order, and chooses Start a return. A prepaid label is issued to print or show at any drop-off point.

### Returns: refunds and setup

Refunds go to the original payment method within 5 business days of the return being scanned in. If the device was set up, the customer should remove it from the app first so the next owner can pair it.

## Warranty

### Warranty: coverage

Every device carries a 2-year limited warranty counted from the delivery date, covering devices that stop working or become unreliable.

### Warranty: starting a claim

To start a warranty claim, ask the customer for the order number or the serial number on the base of the unit, plus a short description of the symptoms.

### Warranty: replacement

An approved claim gets a replacement device with a prepaid label for the faulty one. The customer can keep using the original until the replacement arrives, if it still works.

## Damaged on arrival

### Damaged on arrival: replacement

A device that arrives damaged is replaced at no cost. Ask the customer for a photo of the damage and a photo of the shipping label so a carrier claim can be filed from our side.

### Damaged on arrival: shipping the replacement

Once the photos are received, ship a replacement with a prepaid return label for the damaged unit. The customer does not need to wait for the return to arrive before the replacement ships.

### Damaged on arrival: turnaround

The typical turnaround for a damaged-on-arrival replacement is 2 business days.
